surcharges.name_zh: 過海隧道（紅隧/東隧/西隧）

disclaimer_en: Fare estimate for reference only. The platform is an information intermediary; the final fare is settled voluntarily between passenger and driver (Cap. 374D). Tolls and surcharges depend on the actual route taken.
disclaimer_zh: 車費估價僅供參考。平台僅屬資訊中介，最終車資由乘客與司機自願協商確認（香港法例第374D章）。隧道費及附加費視乎實際路線而定。
